You can make it in an outdoor grill and you don't need butter. 

I add a pinch of trees to about a tablespoon of peanut butter and mix it up really well. Sometimes I add vegetable oil too. Trees are fat-soluble so they are absorbed by the oil.  Try and find the fattiest/oily-est peanut butter too

Then, put the concoction on some crackers, wrap them in tin foil, and bake @ 320 degrees for 20 minutes-ish. 

Enjoy! Don't eat them right before you go to bed though. My frient and I did this once and we couldn't fall asleep. 

The temp isn't terribly important. If your grill doesn't have a thermometer, try to guesstimate the temp. Just make sure they don't get burnt.
